cases.explain: The accusative follows 'за' (for) indicating what is punished.
The genitive follows 'от' (from) when indicating the cause.
The genitive follows 'с' (from) in the sense of removing something from.

reading.ru: Молитва об избавлении Вспомни, о Господь, что случилось с нами.
reading.question: What does the speaker ask God to remember?
options: What has happened to the people
reading.correct: What has happened to the people
reading.explain: The text says 'Remember, O Lord, what has happened to us.'

reading.ru: Наши отцы грешили, их уже нет, а мы несем наказание за их беззаконие.
reading.question: Why do the people suffer for their fathers' sins?
options: They bear punishment for their fathers' lawlessness
They are jealous of their fathers
They refused to listen to prophets
reading.correct: They bear punishment for their fathers' lawlessness
reading.explain: The text explicitly states the people bear punishment for their fathers' iniquities.

reading.ru: Рискуя своей жизнью, мы добываем хлеб свой, потому что меч подстерегает нас в пустыне.
reading.question: Why do they get their bread at the peril of their lives?
options: Because the sword awaits them in the desert
reading.correct: Because the sword awaits them in the desert
reading.explain: The text states: 'We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword of the wilderness.'

reading.ru: Слабеют из-за этого сердца наши, и мрак затмевает глаза.
reading.question: What are the consequences of their suffering?
options: Their hearts faint and darkness dims their eyes
reading.correct: Their hearts faint and darkness dims their eyes
reading.explain: The text says their hearts grow faint and darkness overshadows their eyes.

reading.ru: Почему же ты до сих пор не вспомнил нас?
reading.question: What is the complaint in this verse?
options: Why has God still not remembered them
Why has God given them wealth
Why has God blessed their enemies
reading.correct: Why has God still not remembered them
reading.explain: The speaker asks why God has not remembered them until now.

reading.ru: Верни нас к себе, Господи, и мы возвратимся.
reading.question: What does the speaker ask God to do?
options: Turn them back to God and they will return
Send them to a new land
reading.correct: Turn them back to God and they will return
reading.explain: The prayer asks God to turn them back, and they will be restored.
